channel.title: AI Unfiltered
channel.description: Chinese AI • Open Source • Security • Incidents. Signal, not noise.

item.title: September Phone Wars: Folding iPhones, Wide Foldables and a Wave of Price Hikes
item.description: Apple, Xiaomi and Huawei ready foldable flagships for a crowded September, while rising memory costs push the entire smartphone market toward higher prices.

item.title: GalaxySpace Completes China's First Commercial Whole-Satellite Delivery to Southeast Asia
item.description: GalaxySpace delivered a CubeSat to Thailand's GISTDA via a Long March 6C launch, marking the first whole-satellite build, launch and in-orbit handover by a Chinese commercial space firm to Southeast Asia.

item.title: BBC Looks at China's Robot Revolution: “I Went to Sleep, and the World Changed”
item.description: The BBC visited China's robotics industry, from vocational classrooms to the factory floor, examining how more than two million industrial robots are reshaping the world's manufacturing base.

item.title: Xiaomi's Lu Weibing Shows Xuanjie O100 Prototype: On-Device AI Terminal Without a Rear Camera
item.description: Xiaomi president Lu Weibing unveiled the Xuanjie O100 prototype, an on-device AI terminal that drops the rear camera for dual-chip computing and active air-cooling, running MiMo at about 295 tokens per second.

item.title: WRC 2026: 300-Plus Companies Showcase Applications, Yet Technical Routes Remain Unsettled
item.description: The 11th World Robot Conference in Beijing Yizhuang saw hundreds of companies demonstrate robots doing real work, even as closed-door sessions debated a divergent technical frontier for embodied intelligence.
